brief.headline: Push for earlier payment (15 days sooner) to free up ₹2.60 L of our cash, and benchmark price to the market ask of ₹0.65–0.80/pc for caps at scale.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for pricing in the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volume.
priceAsk.basis: The market ask for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend gives us scale to push toward that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 Days After Receipt to 15 Days After Receipt (cut payment time in half).
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹2.60 L of our cash that's otherwise sitting with them.

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we don't know how tight their cash is or how big a customer we are to their total sales. That means we lean on our own data and on lining up a second source to build our position. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend is significant enough to ask for better terms, especially since multiple strong alternates exist. Without their financial picture, we should push firmly on price and payment but be ready to walk if they won't move — the market has plenty of credible options.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them — enough volume to negotiate scale pricing.
Market pricing for 28 mm PP caps shows room to negotiate down to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume.
Typical market price for this cap is ₹0.85–0.95/pc, so ₹0.65–0.80 is achievable with tighter terms.
Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹2.60 L of our cash.
Current payment terms are 30 Days After Receipt.
HDPE resin import price is 87.61 ₹/kg — a reference for raw-material cost trends.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, makes pharma bottles and caps, health score B (65/100) — strongest second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, robust health B (73/100), makes pharma containers and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Manufacturer with pan-India reach and medium confidence — resin and packaging capability, worth exploring for direct sourcing.

risks: Bprex's financials aren't public, so we can't see if they're cash-tight or healthy — pushing too hard without knowing their position could backfire if they're fragile.

We have no internal price comparison (no best-price-we-pay figure), so our price ask rests entirely on the market ask — make sure the volume and spec assumptions behind ₹0.65–0.80/pc actually match our orders.
All three alternates listed are leads to qualify, not approved sources — start the qualification process now so we have a real fallback if Bprex won't move.
Asking for 15-day payment cuts our float in half and speeds up our cash outflow by ₹2.60 L — confirm with finance that we can afford that before you commit in the room.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹63.21 L a year with you on rigid plastic packaging, and we'd like to talk about tightening payment to 15 days and moving pricing toward the ₹0.65–0.80 range we're seeing in the market for caps at scale.
